title: Future Tense (Review)
description: Comprehensive review of both future tenses
intro: Russian has TWO ways to express the future, and choosing the right one depends on ASPECT. Imperfective future (буду + infinitive) describes ongoing, repeated, or in-progress future actions. Perfective future (conjugated perfective verb) describes single, completed future actions. The key is: What matters - the PROCESS or the RESULT? This lesson reviews both patterns and helps you choose correctly.
rules: Imperfective future: буду/будешь/будет/будем/будете/будут + imperfective infinitive. Focus on PROCESS.
Perfective future: conjugate the perfective verb directly (NO буду). Focus on RESULT/COMPLETION.
Perfective future = completed/finished action: Я прочитаю книгу (I will finish reading the book), Я напишу письмо (I will have written the letter).
Process/duration/repetition → imperfective: Я буду работать весь день. (I will be working all day.)
Single completed action/result → perfective: Я сделаю работу к вечеру. (I will finish the work by evening.)
examples: Что ты будешь делать завтра? — Буду читать. (What will you be doing? — I'll be reading.), process
Ты прочитаешь эту книгу? — Да, прочитаю. (Will you read this book? — Yes, I'll read it.), completion
Мы будем ждать тебя. (We will wait for you.), duration
Мы подождём тебя пять минут. (We will wait for you five minutes.), limited/completed

items.prompt: Я _____ книгу весь вечер. (I will be reading a book all evening.)
items.promptEnglish: I will be reading a book all evening.
items.explanation: 'All evening' indicates duration → imperfective: буду читать.

items.prompt: Я _____ книгу к завтрашнему дню. (I will read the book by tomorrow.)
items.promptEnglish: I will read the book by tomorrow.

items.prompt: Она _____ каждый день. (She will work every day.)
Я обязательно тебе _____! (I will definitely help you!)
Мы _____ тебе с переездом. (We will help you with moving.) - ongoing help
items.promptEnglish: We will help you with moving.

items.prompt: Он _____ тебе завтра. (He will call you tomorrow.) - one call
Дети _____ в парке. (The children will play in the park.) - general activity
items.promptEnglish: The children will play in the park.
items.explanation: Playing in general → imperfective: будут играть.

items.prompt: Когда ты _____ работу? (When will you finish the work?)
items.promptEnglish: When will you finish the work?

items.prompt: Студенты _____ к экзамену долго. (The students will study for the exam for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: The students will study for the exam for a long time.
items.explanation: 'For a long time' = duration → imperfective: будут готовиться.

blanks: Завтра я _____ весь день. (Tomorrow I will be working all day.)
Я _____ эту книгу завтра. (I will read this book tomorrow.) - perfective
Она _____ письмо весь вечер. (She will be writing a letter all evening.) - imperfective
Мы _____ домашнюю работу долго. (We will be doing homework for a long time.) - imperfective
hints: Весь день (all day) means duration. Which future construction expresses an ongoing process?
This book will be read and finished. Is this a result (perfective) or process (imperfective)?
Весь вечер (all evening) means duration. Which future form expresses an ongoing action?
Долго (for a long time) signals duration. Which future form expresses a prolonged process?
explanations: Duration (весь день) requires imperfective future: буду + infinitive → буду работать.
Reading the book to completion is a result → perfective future: прочитаю (no буду).
Duration (весь вечер) requires imperfective future: будет + infinitive → будет писать.
Duration (долго) requires imperfective future: будем + infinitive → будем делать.
